mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_shelf_index ( campus_id, campus_name, area_id, area_name, floor_id, floor_name, room_id, room_name, shelve_id, shelve_name, orders, deleted ) VALUES ( #{campusId}, #{campusName}, #{areaId}, #{areaName}, #{floorId}, #{floorName}, #{roomId}, #{roomName}, #{shelveId}, #{shelveName}, #{orders}, 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE campus_id = VALUES(campus_id), campus_name = VALUES(campus_name), area_id = VALUES(area_id), area_name = VALUES(area_name), floor_id = VALUES(floor_id), floor_name = VALUES(floor_name), room_id = VALUES(room_id), room_name = VALUES(room_name), shelve_name = VALUES(shelve_name), orders = VALUES(orders), deleted = 0, update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE cage_shelf_index SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT campus_id AS campusId, campus_name AS campusName FROM cage_shelf_index WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY campus_id, campus_name ORDER BY campus_id ASC
SELECT CAST(area_id AS CHAR) AS areaId, area_name AS areaName FROM cage_shelf_index WHERE deleted = 0 AND campus_id = #{campusId} GROUP BY area_id, area_name ORDER BY area_id ASC

SELECT id, CAST(shelve_id AS CHAR) AS shelveId, shelve_name AS shelveName, CAST(room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, room_name AS roomName, campus_name AS campusName, floor_name AS floorName FROM cage_shelf_index WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY campus_name ASC, floor_name ASC, room_name ASC, shelve_id ASC

SELECT c.id AS id, CAST(c.campus_id AS CHAR) AS campusId, c.campus_name AS campusName, CAST(c.area_id AS CHAR) AS areaId, c.area_name AS areaName, CAST(c.floor_id AS CHAR) AS floorId, c.floor_name AS floorName, CAST(c.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, c.room_name AS roomName, CAST(c.shelve_id AS CHAR) AS shelveId, c.shelve_name AS shelveName, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.cage_type_code = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS type1, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.cage_type_code = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS type2, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.cage_type_code = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS type3, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.cage_type_code = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS type4 FROM cage_shelf_index c LEFT JOIN cage_cell_index i ON i.shelve_id = c.shelve_id LEFT JOIN cage_cell_detail d ON d.animal_cage_id = i.animal_cage_id WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.campus_id, c.campus_name, c.area_id, c.area_name, c.floor_id, c.floor_name, c.room_id, c.room_name, c.shelve_id, c.shelve_name ORDER BY c.campus_name ASC, c.area_name ASC, c.floor_name ASC, c.room_name ASC, c.shelve_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT CAST(c.shelve_id AS CHAR) AS shelveId, d.project_pi_name AS projectPiName, d.pi_name AS piName, d.department_name AS departmentName FROM cage_shelf_index c JOIN cage_cell_index i ON i.shelve_id = c.shelve_id JOIN cage_cell_detail d ON d.animal_cage_id = i.animal_cage_id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND ((d.project_pi_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.project_pi_name) <> '') OR (d.pi_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.pi_name) <> '') OR (d.department_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.department_name) <> ''))
SELECT (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM cage_cell_detail) AS detailMax, (SELECT MAX(update_time) FROM cage_shelf_index) AS shelfMax
SELECT * FROM cage_shelf_index WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM cage_shelf_index WHERE CAST(shelve_id AS CHAR) = #{shelveId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cage_shelf_index

SELECT * FROM cage_shelf_index WHERE deleted = 0
AND CAST(shelve_id AS CHAR) IN #{sid}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY campus_id, area_id, floor_id, room_id, shelve_id

SELECT CAST(shelve_id AS CHAR) AS shelve_id FROM cage_shelf_index WHERE deleted = 0
AND CAST(room_id AS CHAR) IN #{rid}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY orders ASC, CAST(shelve_id AS UNSIGNED) ASC
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(room_id AS CHAR) FROM cage_shelf_index WHERE deleted = 0 AND ( room_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roomNamePart}, '%') OR #{roomNamePart} LIKE CONCAT('%', room_name, '%') )

SELECT id, campus_id AS campusId, campus_name AS campusName, area_id AS areaId, area_name AS areaName, floor_id AS floorId, floor_name AS floorName, room_id AS roomId, room_name AS roomName, shelve_id AS shelveId, shelve_name AS shelveName, orders, deleted, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM cage_shelf_index WHERE room_name = #{roomName} AND campus_name = #{campusName} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
